reason: Lists the few profiles on this computer, every one at once by design (WC-ACCT-12), as gcal-cli's session list does; a filter would let a caller narrow it to one and read that as the only profile.

Calls one Bitrix24 method by its API name, the same command gcal-cli and drive-cli have; no shared verb names a raw API call. Review when the vocabulary names it: https://github.com/WireCatLabs/cli-base/issues/425
